versions.content: Purpose of SdgDef The Special Data Group Definition SdgDef specifies the structure of Sdg s that are accepted in AUTOSAR Model s. The struc- ture is defined by specifying a Meta-Model using SdgClass es and its SdgAt- tribute s ( SdgPrimitiveAttribute s, SdgPrimitiveAttributeWithVaria- tion s, SdgReference s, SdgAggregationWithVariation s, SdgForeignRef- erence s and SdgForeignReferenceWithVariation s).
